suite.doc:
Test suite covering the Login page of DemoWebShop (https://demowebshop.tricentis.com/login).
Design: strict L1 (element) / L2 (business) / L3 (test case) layering. Test cases below call ONLY L2/L1 keywords - never a raw SeleniumLibrary keyword or a hardcoded locator - keeping this file readable as plain-English business steps.
Test Case 02 registers a fresh account so Test Case 03 has a guaranteed-valid login (DemoWebShop requires a registered account; there is no fixed set of valid demo credentials).
